registeredBefore: historical odds provenance/payout comparison and forecast artifact deployability evaluation

boundary.sourceSnapshots: only r4/OOF pinned and already-opened data; no September/Q4 URLs, files, results or inference

inspect: per-day JSON schema and generation logic
raw artifact metadata and source SHA
verify: single or multiple snapshots per race
whether a fixed T-minus-5-minute horizon is provable

payoutComparison.source: r4 run 35940833546 v016-r4-raw-2025 or v016-r4-features/development.npz, identical race keys and source hashes
payoutComparison.selection: all July-August eligible settled six-boat races with valid winning trifecta, positive payout and positive finite archived winning odds; report every exclusion from broader population separately
payoutComparison.oddsUnits: payout amount in yen per 100 yen divided by 100 to odds; preserve source numeric odds; report exact equality at stored precision and separately source-documented rounding convention if any
payoutComparison.distribution: signed odds minus payout/100, absolute difference; count, mean, median, p90, p95, p99, minimum, maximum; monthly and venue grouping; top 20 absolute mismatches with race key only
payoutComparison.interpretation: close agreement can suggest near-final values but cannot establish pre-close collection

population.method: reuse source raw metadata and existing July-August raw artifact; classify source fields where present, otherwise report unobservable separately; do not infer direction of selection bias without matched evidence

oddsDecision.ODDS_PRE_CLOSE_VERIFIED: direct durable per-race timing/process proof that the consumed snapshot predates that race's close by the claimed horizon
oddsDecision.ODDS_NOT_SUITABLE_FOR_REALIZABLE_BACKTES: direct evidence snapshot is captured after close/start, is final-postrace, or otherwise cannot represent a purchasable quote
oddsDecision.ODDS_PRE_CLOSE_NOT_VERIFIED: otherwise, including a timestamp-free archive or uncertain update/retention path
oddsDecision.roiPromotionWhenUnverified: suspend ROI-based purchase-model promotion on this archive; do not change thresholds

forecast.candidate: r4 market-free reaction Model A, run 35940833546 artifact 10784912368, development 2025 July-August; OOF run 35982657474 reproduces Model A quality
forecast.compare: verify Model A and Android v0.15.16 pure AI metrics from existing repository results; disclose population/key differences rather than claiming paired gain
manifest: three conditional LightGBM stages and temperature

readiness.FORECAST_READY_FOR_INTEGRATION_DESIGN_PE: artifacts and hashes verified, market-free model confirmed, and concrete Android inference/history implementation contract can be specified without modifying production
readiness.FORECAST_NOT_DEPLOYABLE_YET: missing or unverifiable model/state/schema/source or unresolved inference/history compatibility blocker
readiness.FORECAST_REJECTED_ON_EXISTING_EVIDENCE: forecast quality itself fails the existing same-window evidence; no ROI-based judgment

guards: reject any cache record dated September 2025 or later before feature/result access
no CLI date input can allow September/Q4
workflow only checks out, reads, and writes scripts/v016_integrity_* and data/v016_integrity_* / data/v016_forecast_* plus WORK_HANDOFF.md
no app/ or release path mutation
model and state hashes must match cited artifact
